lessons_used: Predictions generally overestimate noise-corrected outcomes, though winning tests frequently exceed expected gains.
Finish hints were helpful, winning in two out of three tests.
Choose path hints showed no clear positive effect or degraded performance across four tests.
Adoption layout changes showed no clear positive effect or degraded performance across two tests.
Home notifications showed no clear positive effect across two tests.
Evidence remains thin for change kinds tested only once.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Photo Validation Flow
candidates.change: Adds an interactive validation flow to photo upload with live quality status badges before pet creation.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, causing user drop-off in adoption.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[1]': a preview cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Post-Onboarding Control Summary Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated summary screen detailing pet controls, hiding shortcuts, and interaction commands right before finishing.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 complaints from users unclear on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

new_control_summary.headline: Desktop Pet Controls
new_control_summary.body: Use quick shortcuts to summon, hide, or interact with your companion on your desktop at any time.

guard.reason: Adding a control summary screen after home_intro is explicitly allowed under Rule 4, and no required steps are removed.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen on the finish step historically reduced conversion (-2.0%) and requires full UI release.

candidates.title: Move Sign-In After Friend Selection
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in step to occur immediately after choosing a pet, building attachment before asking for authentication.
candidates.why: Sign-in right after path choice creates early drop-off before users feel invested in a specific pet.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to occur after friend selection is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in targets a high-drop step (20%) with mild historical success (+0.2%), but requires flow refactoring.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Progress Checklist Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the waiting screen layout into a checklist displaying setup milestones as pet assets download.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s; a checklist layout keeps users informed during long loads.

guard.reason: Redesigning the waiting screen layout into a checklist retains its job of showing the pet is being prepared.

candidates.score_note: Redesigning home screen previously yielded +2.7% (1 test), but home step already has high completion (92.1%).

candidates.title: Story Value Narrative Headline Clarification
candidates.change: Updates the story screen headline and body text to clearly explain the desktop pet concept up front.
candidates.why: Path selection drops ~20.6% of users due to unclear early expectations of what the app provides.

story.headline: Your New Desktop Companion Awaits
story.body: Choose how your pet joins your daily workflow—as a quick ready-made buddy or a personalized companion.

guard.reason: Updating story screen copy clarifies the pet concept without violating copy/pricing restrictions.

candidates.score_note: Low cost text change addressing high initial drop-off (20.6%), matching earlier +0.8% copy trial.

candidates.title: Finish Screen Quick Control Callout Hint
candidates.change: Adds a hint on the finish screen displaying key shortcuts for toggling pet visibility on desktop.
candidates.why: Finish hints previously won 2 out of 3 tests, and support reports users struggling to hide or control their pet.

home_intro.hint: Press Alt+P anytime on your desktop to instantly show or hide your pet.

guard.reason: Adding a shortcut callout hint to the home intro overlay stays within onboarding and introduces no dark patterns.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment: support complaints and funnel drop point here, and finish hints consistently win (+4.0%).

candidates.title: Sign-In Account Safety Reassurance Hint
candidates.change: Adds explanatory hint copy to the sign-in screen assuring users that signing in prevents pet loss.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets reported missing or reset pets after re-signing in; explicit reassurance addresses user anxiety.

sign_in.hint: Signing in securely backs up your pet's personality and progress across all your devices.

guard.reason: Adding explanatory reassurance hint copy to sign-in is allowed and does not request new personal data.

candidates.score_note: 8 support tickets and 20% sign-in drop provide strong evidence for a simple, low-cost copy reassurance hint.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Official Seal Incentive
candidates.change: Adds a decorative official companion seal badge component to the adoption certificate.
candidates.why: The adoption stage takes median 89s with ~18% drop-off; an official badge adds a rewarding milestone moment.

guard.reason: Adding a companion seal badge component to the adoption certificate maintains the certificate function.

candidates.score_note: Untested change category (incentive) on adoption step; evidence remains thin.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Asset Time Estimate
candidates.change: Enables the estimated remaining time indicator component on the waiting screen during asset loading.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s; displaying time estimates sets clear patience expectations for long downloads.

guard.reason: Enabling a time estimate indicator for asset loading reflects a real wait, which is allowed under Rule 5.

candidates.score_note: High confidence config change (+0.8% across 11 tests) targeting long load times (median 201s).

candidates.title: Split Layout Friend Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a split layout with pet options on the left and live details on the right.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion is 81.9%; a split layout gives equal visibility to pet options and character details.

guard.reason: Redesigning the pick friend screen to a split layout preserves the core job of choosing a pet.

candidates.score_note: Redesign shows modest gains (+1.2%), but adoption layout changes specifically degraded conversion in past tests (-2.3%).
